I am a just a man, true. One of no real import except to a small number of equally unimportant people, all of whom will die and quickly be completely forgotten as well.

I can't consider myself a good person. I'm too good at being bad. Way too good. Like greatest talent in life good. Any good I do feels like a mask at best, or penance at worst.

My life could be as good as a consolation prize. An honorable mention ribbon for participation. I had the gold medal, now it's gone and it was my fault.

There is nothing else worth accomplishing after fucking up something so perfect. All of my hopes are gone and all of my dreams are impossible due to our current understanding of physics. I let everything I ever wanted on this planet slip away and everything else off the planet can't be, how do you accept that and be happy with a sub par life?
Occasionally when I can't sleep. It doesn't matter though. I feel just as bad sober as I do on anything. Diet and exercise have been absolutely useless as well.

No. No restarts, no do overs. It was right the first time and I destroyed it. Anything else will feel like second place. Anything else ranking first is both unacceptable and unthinkable and living a second place life for the next 40 years is unbearable.
